_about: Muni Golf recipe. Starts the Muni Golf Launcher, presses Update when one is offered (otherwise Play), waits for the game and brings it to the front, and adds a Driving Range shortcut (Practice > Facilities > Muni Driving Range). Muni Golf installs per Windows account under %LOCALAPPDATA%. Tested with Muni Golf Launcher 2026.10.6 / game 2026.10.3.
title: Golf Simulator
subtitle: Choose a simulator to start

beforeEachSim._note: Muni runs as the launcher, a small starter (MuniGolf), the Unreal game (MuniGolf-Win64-Shipping) and its launch monitor bridge (LaunchMonitorConnect).
beforeEachSim.label: Closing leftover sim apps

muniBoot._note: The launcher is an Electron app, so its buttons are pressed through UI Automation. Its nav bar also has a 'Play' link; clickButton prefers the real Play button. settle gives the update check a few seconds to light up Update before Play is pressed.
muniBoot.label: Updating if needed, then pressing Play
Bringing Muni Golf to the front

muniRange._note: The game is an Unreal app, so its menu is read with OCR.
muniRange.label: Opening Practice

muniRange._note: No confirmGone on this or the next step: the following screens also show the same words (PRACTICE FACILITIES heading, the range's minimap title).
muniRange.label: Opening Facilities

muniRange._note: The built-in range. Swap in another installed facility's name to practise somewhere else.
